sentences.text:
This is first application filed by applicant under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of anticipatory bail relating to FIR No.762/2023 registered at Police Station-City Kotwali Chhatarpur, District-Chhatarpur (M.P.) for the offences under Sections 420, 34 of the IPC.
2 .
Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that as per prosecution story, one Nitin Soni has taken gold from jewellery makers and he did not pay the balance amount of 128 grams of gold.
Nitin Soni is main accused in the case.

Allegation against the applicant is that he is father-in-law and assured return of money, but he did not return the money and on the contrary,
took all the belongings in a shop and absconding.
It is submitted that applicant has no role in the main act which has been committed.
In these circumstances, applicant be released on anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: Learned Government Advocate for the State opposed the anticipatory bail application.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5.
Principal allegations are made against one Nitin Soni, who has not returned the money of 128 grams of gold.
Applicant is said to have indirectly helped the main accused person by removing the belongings in the shop of one Nitin Soni, but he has no role in allurement or not making any payment of gold.
6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, anticipatory bail application filed by applicant is allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest of applicant by the police in the aforesaid crime, applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting officer (Investigating Officer) for his regular appearance before the Police during the investigation or before the Court during trial.
7. The applicant is directed to join the investigation immediately and co-operate with the investigating agency.

He will further abide by the conditions enumerated in sub-section (2) of Section 438 of the Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE sp/-
